# bash: extend lookup script by showing comments

Make `lookup <function>` show the function *with its comments*. `lookup datetime` prints the body as the shell has it in memory — the note quotes the whole reformatted `datetime` function — and "it doesn't contain comments and sometimes it's difficult to understand what exactly this code means". The source file has the explanatory comments; the shell discards them on definition.
